definitions: An instruction, command, or duty given to a person or group of people.
A group of people entrusted by a government or other authority with a particular duty or task.
A payment made to an agent or salesperson for their services, especially a percentage of the amount of business transacted.
The act of committing a crime or offence.
An order for something, especially a work of art, to be produced specially.
The state of being in working order or use.
examples: He was given a commission to investigate the matter.
The Royal Commission on Criminal Justice.
She earns a 10% commission on every sale.
A commission for a new sculpture.
He received his commission as a lieutenant.
The new power station is now in commission.
